"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Roughly 40 percent of the world's population is under 25.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure that policies and those of partners and development institutions work to increase economic opportunities for young people around the world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure that policies and those of partners and development institutions work to expand education for young people around the world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure that policies and those of partners and development institutions work to improve health care for young people around the world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will pay special attention to protecting the rights of youth.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will nurture young leaders from vulnerable or underrepresented communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States has an urgent, moral obligation and strategic interest to help alleviate suffering around the globe.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Entrenched conflicts and unprecedented levels of forced migration have pushed the world into an acute humanitarian crisis that spills across borders.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Almost 170 million people are going to need humanitarian assistance this year.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"By 2022 that figure could top 200 million.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Need is poised to continue outstripping growth in humanitarian funding and capacity.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will reassert America's humanitarian example and leadership.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will contribute not just more aid, but better aid.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States ought to drive the international community in providing more strategic, coordinated, proactive, predictable, and cost-effective funding.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States ought to drive the international community in implementing programs that reflect the realities of today's increasingly complex and protracted humanitarian emergencies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States ought to drive the international community in implementing programs that deliver on the health needs of populations devastated by conflict and displacement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States ought to drive the international community in implementing programs that deliver on the education needs of populations devastated by conflict and displacement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States ought to drive the international community in implementing programs that deliver on the protection needs of populations devastated by conflict and displacement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
